reports.title: Accepted solutions
reports.description: How many topics had a solution accepted per day in a date range, with optional category filter and a 30-day comparison total.

reports.title: Activity by category
reports.description: Topics, posts, and member participation per category in the selected period. Share is each category's percentage of total activity across the listed categories; Vs Prior is the change in share compared with the previous period of equal length.

reports.title: Admin Logins
reports.description: List of admin login times with locations.

reports.title: Anonymous Browser Pageviews
reports.description: Number of pageviews by anonymous visitors using real browsers.

reports.title: DAU / MAU
reports.description: The share of monthly active members who returned in the last day. This percentage shows how regularly people come back; also called the community 'stickiness'. Aim for > 20%.

reports.title: Daily Engaged Users
reports.description: Number of users that have liked or posted in the last day.

reports.title: Emails Sent
reports.description: Number of new emails sent.

reports.title: Embedded pageviews
reports.description: Number of pageviews served inside the full app embed iframe.

reports.title: Legacy Consolidated Pageviews
reports.description: Legacy report showing pageviews for logged in users, anonymous users and crawlers. This has been superseded by the 'Site traffic' report.

reports.title: Legacy Pageviews
reports.description: Legacy report showing the number of new pageviews from all visitors.

reports.title: Logged In Browser Pageviews
reports.description: Number of pageviews by logged-in visitors using real browsers.

reports.title: Moderator Activity
reports.description: List of moderator activity including flags reviewed, reading time, topics created, posts created, personal messages created, and revisions.

reports.title: New Contributors
reports.description: Number of users who made their first post during this period.

reports.title: Pageviews
reports.description: Number of new pageviews from all visitors.

reports.title: Posts
reports.description: New posts created during this period

reports.title: Signups
reports.description: New account registrations for this period.

reports.title: Site traffic
reports.description: Pageviews for logged in users, anonymous users, known crawlers and other traffic.

reports.title: Time to first response
reports.description: Average time (in hours) of the first response to new topics.

reports.title: Top Ignored / Muted Users
reports.description: Users who have been muted and/or ignored by many other users.

reports.title: Top Referred Topics
reports.description: Topics that have received the most clicks from external sources.

reports.title: Top Traffic Sources
reports.description: External sources that have linked to this site the most.

reports.title: Top Uploads
reports.description: List all uploads by extension, filesize and author.

reports.title: Top Users by likes received
reports.description: Top 10 users who have received likes.

reports.title: Top countries
reports.description: Countries driving the most browser pageviews to your forum in the selected period.

reports.title: Top entry URLs
reports.description: Pages that received the most direct or externally referred browser visits in the selected period.

reports.title: Top referrers
reports.description: External sites referring the most browser pageviews to your forum in the selected period.

reports.title: Topic View Stats
reports.description: The top 100 most viewed topics in a date range, combining logged in and anonymous views. Can be filtered by category.

reports.title: Topics
reports.description: New topics created during this period.

reports.title: Topics with no response
reports.description: Number of new topics created that did not receive a response.

reports.title: Trending Search Terms
reports.description: Most popular search terms with their click-through rates.

reports.title: Trust level pipeline
reports.description: Member movement between trust levels for the selected period. Counts the members currently at each trust level, their share of the total membership, the number of members promoted or demoted into each trust level during the period, and new sign-ups.

reports.title: User Visits
reports.description: Number of signed-in user visits by device type.

reports.title: User-to-User (with replies)
reports.description: Number of all new personal messages and responses.

reports.title: Users per Trust Level
reports.description: Number of users grouped by trust level.

reports.title: Users per Type
reports.description: Number of users grouped by admin, moderator, suspended, and silenced.

reports.title: Web Crawler Pageviews
reports.description: Total pageviews from web crawlers over time.

reports.title: Web Crawler User Agents
reports.description: List of web crawler user agents, sorted by pageviews.

reports.title: Who's posting?
reports.description: Posts authored in the selected period, bucketed by member type. "New members" signed up during the period, "Returning" signed up before it, and "Staff" are admins or moderators.
